newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee to be dry then see some rain - Somar.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee to be dry then see some rain - Somar.

text.p: Brazil's coffee regions will be warm and rain-free until Aug 21 when a cold front will lead to cloudier weather and isolated showers Aug 22-23, meteorologist Somar said Monday.
The scattered rain will be in the north of Parana, Sao Paulo and south Minas Gerais but the Cerrado region of Minas Gerais will remain dry, Somar said.
The polar air mass associated with the cold front will not reach the coffee regions, affecting only the far south of the country.

Minimum temperatures in the last 24 hours ranged between eight degrees Celsius in Pocos de Caldas, Minas Gerais, traditionally Brazil's coldest coffee region and 17 degrees Celsius in southern Sao Paulo state, Somar said.
According to the latest models, no cold air is forecast to enter the coffee belt in the next seven days, Somar said.
